## Functional overview

**Purpose:**
Documents the postponement of the general meeting for VOL filers.

## Scenarios & edge cases

### Happy path
- The general meeting is postponed within the legal deadline -> the new date is recorded.

## FAQ / support answers

**Q:** Why does the postponement date not appear on the export?
**A:** It only appears once the governance body confirms the new date.
